name: ask_nl_question
description: Ask a natural-language question about anything in the wiki. Spawns a one-shot Q&A sub-agent with read-only access (`search_wiki` + `read_page`). Returns `{answer, sources: [{path}, ...]}`. Use this when you want a synthesized answer rather than raw doc bodies — e.g. 'how do triggers work?', 'what's the status of the chat agent?'. The sub-agent will not write or propose edits. Sync: blocks until the answer is ready (typically 5-30 seconds).

query.description: The question to answer. Plain English; no special syntax.
